Package com.elotouch.elopay.library.usb

Interface UsbPortSwitcher

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort, EloPeripheralManager.UsbPort
    public interface UsbPortSwitcher
    Interface definition for USB port configuration for the internal hub and external hub.

      • HUB_EXT_POS_HUB

        static final int HUB_EXT_POS_HUB
        The pos hub of the handheld (payment) models:
        • 1. It is an external USB hub and connected to android device with type C usb port.
        • 2. Support hot plug and unplug detection.

        must sync with vendor.elo.hardware.oemusbconfig.V1_0.Device#EXT_POS_HUB

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • HUB_EXT_IO_HUB

        static final int HUB_EXT_IO_HUB
        The IO hub of i-series and USBC models:
        • 1. There is not any POS port (such as cash drawer) on this USB hub.
        • 2. It is an external USB hub and connected to android device with type C usb port.
        • 3. Support hot plug detection.

        must sync with vendor.elo.hardware.oemusbconfig.V1_0.Device#EXT_IO_DONGLE

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • HUB_EXT_POS_STAND_CFD

        static final int HUB_EXT_POS_STAND_CFD
        The POS stand hub of i-series and USBC models:
        • 1. There is built-in CFD which is used as second display.
        • 2. There are POS ports (such as cash drawer) on this USB hub.
        • 3. It is an external USB hub and connected to android device with type C usb port.
        • 4. Support hot plug detection.

        must sync with vendor.elo.hardware.oemusbconfig.V1_0.Device#EXT_POS_STAND_WITH_CFD

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • HUB_EXT_POS_STAND_NO_CFD

        static final int HUB_EXT_POS_STAND_NO_CFD
        The POS stand hub of i-series and USBC models:
        • 1. There is not built-in CFD
        • 2. There is a USBC port can connect DP device or TYPE-C usb device.
        • 3. There are POS ports (such as cash drawer) on this USB hub.
        • 4. It is an external USB hub and connected to android device with type C usb port.
        • 5. Support hot plug detection.

        must sync with vendor.elo.hardware.oemusbconfig.V1_0.Device#EXT_POS_STAND_NO_CFD

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • HUB_EXT_FLIP_STAND_NO_CFD

        static final int HUB_EXT_FLIP_STAND_NO_CFD
        The flip stand hub of i-series and USBC models:
        • 1. There is not built-in CFD.
        • 2. There is DC output port to provide power to the i-series.
        • 3. There is a USBC port can connect DP device or TYPE-C usb device.
        • 4. There are POS ports (such as cash drawer) on this USB hub.
        • 5. It is an external USB hub and connected to android device with type C usb port.
        • 6. Support hot plug detection.

        must sync with vendor.elo.hardware.oemusbconfig.V1_0.Device#EXT_FLIP_STAND

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

    • Method Detail

      • enableUsbPort

        void enableUsbPort​(int port,
                   boolean enable,
                   int roleFlag,
                   android.os.Message onComplete)
        Request to enable/disable data or power role of the given USB port.
        Parameters:
        port - is the port id that you are requesting to enable/disable, define in com.elotouch.library.EloPeripheralManager or com.elotouch.library.EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort
        enable - is a boolean representing the state that you are requesting, true for enabled, false for disabled.
        roleFlag - indicate to switch data role, power role, or both
        onComplete - a callback message when the action is completed.if onComplete is null, don't send callback message when completed.

      • enableAllUsbPorts

        void enableAllUsbPorts​(boolean enable,
                       int roleFlag,
                       android.os.Message onComplete)
        Request to all enable/disable USB ports.
        Parameters:
        enable - is a boolean representing the state that you are requesting, true for enabled, false for disabled.
        roleFlag - indicate to switch data role, power role, or both.
        onComplete - a callback message when the action is completed. if onComplete is null, don't send callback message when completed.

      • enableDisableUsbPortList

        void enableDisableUsbPortList​(int[] portlist,
                              boolean[] statusList,
                              int roleFlag,
                              android.os.Message onComplete)
        Request to enable/disable multiple USB ports with list
        Parameters:
        portlist - is the port id list that you are requesting to enable/disable, and the port id defines in com.elotouch.library.EloPeripheralManager or com.elotouch.library.EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort
        statusList - is the enable/disable status list, enable is a boolean representing the state that you are requesting, true for enabled, false for disabled.
        roleFlag - indicate to switch data role, power role, or both.
        onComplete - a callback message when the action is completed.if onComplete is null, don't send callback message when completed.

      • isUsbPortEnabled

        boolean isUsbPortEnabled​(int port,
                         int roleFlag)
        Whether the given the USB port is enabled or not.
        Parameters:
        port - is the port id that you are requesting to enable/disable, define in com.elotouch.library.EloPeripheralManager.UsbPort or com.elotouch.library.EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort
        Returns:
        true means this USB port is enabled, false means this USB port is disabled

      • getUsbPortStatus

        boolean[] getUsbPortStatus​(int roleFlag)
        Query the data (power) on/off status for all user controllable USB ports.
        Parameters:
        roleFlag - indicate to query data role or power role status. see ROLE_FLAG_XXX in UsbPortSwitcher.
        Returns:
        boolean array for the USB port status, e.g: retValue[0] = true means USB port1 is enabled,false means USB port1 is disable
